fields.Property Note:
The Property to be sold is located in the Township of Edison, County of Middlesex, & State of NJ, & is commonly known as 59 Beechwood Ave., & as tax lot 5 in block 690.17 (fka 690Q), with nearest cross street being New York Ave., & with dimension of lot being approximately 75 ft by 100 ft.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice through publication.
Upset Price is set at $287,540, & subject Creditor Judgment Debtor reserves the right to accept a lesser Bid but no obligation.
Sale is being made in accord with (i) Court Order issued 6/27/2004 (Essex County Superior Court, Docket MID-C-96-23), which leaves open that after Bankruptcy as was filed being concluded/ which it has, if the balance on this debt, same as being secured as a lien on the referenced property being sold, remains, such bankruptcy referenced herein being concluded without sale of PQ, the possibility of such sale so as to satisfy more fully this Creditor’s Secured Lien claim remains viable; and (ii) associated Writ of Execution dated 7/28/26 to enforce collection on current balance on outstanding Judgment
No. J-144222-2011 dated 4/11/2011 NJ docketed 5/17/2011. There is a prior mortgage lien also attached to title recorded 5/7/2003 in mbk 8355 at pg 516, same having subsequently been assigned & modified through several subsequently filed instruments but understanding is that amount due is less than Upset Price; & one tax sale certificate (no. 19-00473); & there appears of record a second mortgage subsequent to the docketing of the above referenced Judgment same being recorded 3/19/2018 in mbk 17116 at Pg 1965, & a UCC Financing Statement also filed subsequent to such
Judgment docketing filed as instrument #2021141686 on 11/16/2021.
